newsitem.title: USA: Credit Lyonnais Americas names new CEO.
newsitem.headline: Credit Lyonnais Americas names new CEO.

text.p: Credit Lyonnais said on Wednesday it named Jerome Brunel chief executive of Credit Lyonnais Americas.

Brunel, who will take the position on March 1, succeeds Robert Cohen. The company said Cohen would be joining Republic New York Corp and Republic National Bank of New York as a vice chairman and a member of the boards. Credit Lyonnais said Cohen was offered a senior executive position in Paris, but he was unable to leave New York for family reasons.
With combined assets in excess of $43 billion, Credit Lyonnais Americas encompasses all the bank's operations in the United States, Canada and Latin America.
The company said Brunel is currently the bank's general manager in Hong Kong, responsible for operations in China, Hong Kong, Taiwan and the Philippines.
